answer: Opened coffee is final sale (docs/policy.md). Unopened bags may be returned within 14 days with a receipt for Hearth card credit.
The cafe does not ship pastries, including a cardamom bun (docs/policy.md).
The guest network is hearth-guest (docs/faq.md). The password is printed on the paper receipt. It is not written in this file.
Cardamom buns contain almonds (docs/faq.md). There is no nut-free preparation area, so we cannot offer a nut-free bun.
Refunds are store credit on a Hearth card only (docs/policy.md). The cafe does not give cash refunds.
The cafe is closed Monday (docs/faq.md). Tuesday through Friday the hours are 7:30-15:30.
Bike delivery runs Tuesday through Friday (docs/policy.md), not on Saturday. The fee is $4.50.
The shipping fee on coffee orders under $40 is $6.00 (docs/policy.md). Orders of $40 or more ship free.
Whole-bean and ground coffee ships inside the United States only (docs/policy.md). The cafe does not ship to Canada.
The delivery fee is $4.50 (docs/policy.md). Orders of $35 or more are delivered free.
